deployable_scope.all_other_sectors: frozen exactly at the sequential reviewed fallback action
deployable_scope.critical_sector_stream_action: fixed RZF directions and continuous per-stream power scales; actual post-mode conducted power sum_k P_q,bk x_bk must not exceed the reviewed fallback scalar s_b times the original q=0 nominal conducted sector power sum_k P_0,bk
deployable_scope.critical_serving_sectors: serving sectors of currently floor-violating active eligible users
deployable_scope.external_and_eess_sector_action: one frozen-grid sector scalar, backoff/mute only; never above reviewed fallback

diagnostic_oracles: global frozen 0--12 dB plus mute sector-grid MILP
optimistic all-other-streams-muted single-user EESS-safe upper bound
forbidden: increase numerical tolerance to hide failure
use sum rate as primary objective

objective.primary: all active eligible-user floors and all physical-second long/short EESS constraints
objective.secondary: minimum weighted L1 deviation from sequential reviewed fallback

physical_power_contract.left_hand_side: actual post-mode conducted stream powers after the frozen 65/3 dB command
physical_power_contract.right_hand_side: reviewed fallback sector scalar times immutable q=0 nominal conducted sector power
physical_power_contract.selected_constraint: sum_k P_q,bk x_bk <= s_b sum_k P_0,bk
physical_power_contract.strict_comparator: sum_k P_q,bk x_bk <= s_b sum_k P_q,bk; diagnostic only because it double-counts mode attenuation as an available-power restriction

repair_hierarchy: bounded sparse local frozen sector-grid repair
bounded q=0-envelope critical-sector fixed-RZF stream redistribution plus sparse external/EESS backoff
global exact oracles for feasibility classification only
optimistic single-user fixed-class upper bound if deployable action is unresolved
validation_assumptions: q=0 nominal sector-power envelope is available conducted-power budget after the reviewed scalar
per-stream fixed-RZF reweighting is supported within the update interval
per-chain and PA constraints not represented by total conducted power require later validation
